title: ReAct Step Tool Safe-Loop Dispatch Invariant
author: Brain Harness Reflector

claims.assertion: Synchronous tool wrapper entrypoints in Harness plugins that delegate to asynchronous service coroutines must never call bare asyncio.run(), which throws RuntimeError under active proactor event loops.

Wrapping coroutine execution in a safe runner that checks asyncio.get_running_loop() and delegates to a concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor enables deterministic synchronous dispatch inside active async agent proactors.
